title: Nursing Supervisor
must_have: 6+ years of experience in clinical nursing
text:
Nursing Supervisor
Dhanvantari Care Institute | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a nursing supervisor to join our clinical nursing team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Medication Administration
- Wound Care
- Basic Life Support
- Infection Control
- IV Therapy
- 6+ years of experience in clinical nursing

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Ventilator Management
- Pediatric Care
- Dialysis Care
- Patient Assessment

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive emergency admissions workflow with measurable outcomes.
- Drive medical-surgical unit handover with measurable outcomes.
- Drive post-operative ward coordination with measurable outcomes.
